approved_scope.title: The upstream archive lookup reads tree entries as bytes and knows an archive HEAD already holds after an upstream rename
approved_scope.description: The upstream archive lookup reads tree entries as bytes and knows an archive HEAD already holds after an upstream rename
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-change-129 refuses only an archive of the same change id that HEAD does not contain, and never one HEAD already contains; REQ-change-142 reports cannot-tell only when Git cannot list or read the records. An unrelated non-UTF-8 package name made the lookup cannot-tell (#961), and an upstream rename made an archive HEAD holds read as remote-only (#945)
acceptance_criteria: an unrelated archive package with a non-UTF-8 directory name on the remote default does not stop the lookup, and this change's upstream archive is still found; an archive HEAD already holds is not reported after the remote default renames its package; a non-UTF-8 package that does hold this change's record is still cannot-tell
